summary.comparison_scope: Actual finite final/joint pilot, case-list and trace-list controls. Analysis is separate from byte preservation.
Finite actual native graph/error outcomes; no probability, universal support or full parity claim.

limits: Finite paired captures do not establish universal final or joint selection laws or full parity.
Weighted named adjacency is not general isomorphism for duplicate names.
Raw graph outputs, diagnostic values, actual command logs and input orders are preserved without rewriting.
Native PYTHONHASHSEED records context and does not seed the native RNG.
Compiled core provenance and actual capture context HEAD are distinct.
Binaries are bound by exact SHA and bytes, not embedded.
Historical preparation-only records are not actual discovery executions.
roundtrip: Every exact UTF-8 member byte/SHA/count and header/tail verified; one member at a time.
